parameters.name: email

parameters.help_en: The timeout period for the check, in seconds. If this parameter is not specified or is set to 0, the default value is 20 seconds in FULL mode and 3 seconds in BASIC_ONLY mode. If a value from 1 to 20 is specified, the specified value is used. If a value greater than 20 is specified, 20 seconds is used. This value specifies the maximum wait time for the check. The check returns immediately if it completes early. Overhead such as quota checks is not included in the timeout period
parameters.help_zh: 检测超时时间，单位为秒。未传入或传入 0 时，FULL 模式默认使用 20 秒，BASIC_ONLY 模式默认使用 3 秒。传入 1～20 时使用指定值，超过 20 时按 20 秒处理。该值为检测的最长等待时间，检测提前完成即返回；额度校验等链路开销不计入检测超时时间
parameters.name: timeout

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to check the graylist. Default value: false. The result is asynchronously notified through EventBridge
parameters.help_zh: 是否检查灰名单，默认为否。结果将通过eventbridge异步通知
parameters.name: check_graylist

parameters.help_en:
The check type. Valid values:

FULL: enables all check capabilities, including SMTP probing. Because SMTP probing involves remote connections, the overall latency is high. This value is suitable for scenarios that are not sensitive to response time. A single check consumes one address validation quota. In this mode, the UNKNOWN status is not metered.
BASIC_ONLY: enables all check capabilities except SMTP probing, with low latency. This value is suitable for scenarios that are sensitive to response time, such as real-time validation of email addresses during registration to check whether the address is a disposable email or an abnormal address such as an MX forwarding address, to defend against batch registration by the cyber underground economy chain. A single check consumes one-third of an address validation quota. In this mode, the UNKNOWN status is metered
parameters.help_zh:
检测类型：

FULL：启用全部检测能力，包括 SMTP 探测。由于 SMTP 探测涉及远程连接，整体延迟较高，适用于对响应时间不敏感的场景。单次检测消费1个地址校验额度。该模式下UNKNOWN状态不会计量。
BASIC_ONLY：启用除 SMTP 探测外的所有检测能力，延迟低。适用于对响应时间敏感的场景，例如注册环节实时校验邮箱地址是否为一次性邮箱或 MX 转发等异常地址，以防御黑灰产批量注册。单次检测消费1/3个地址校验额度。该模式下UNKNOWN状态会计量
parameters.name: probe_type
